name: Lightning Arrow
casting_time: 1 bonus action, which you take immediately after hitting or missing a target with a ranged attack using a weapon
description: The triggering ranged attack becomes lightning instead of applying its normal damage or effects. The target takes 4d8 Lightning damage on a hit or half on a miss; creatures within 10 feet then make a Dexterity save, taking 2d8 Lightning damage on a failure or half on a success. **Higher-Level Slots.** Both damage rolls increase by 1d8 per slot level above 3.
